leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a generic function that extracts property values from an array of objects.
Apply the keyof operator to constrain a generic type parameter to valid object keys.
Construct a return type for the pluck function that matches the type of the extracted property.
Configure the function signature to accept an array of objects and a property key.
Manipulate the input array using the map method to produce an array of property values.
Integrate the generic type parameters to ensure type safety across the function implementation.
Initialize a test scenario with sample data to verify the pluck function's type inference and output.
